author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 4.6.5 adds a Version line under the Advanced Configuration page heading (so it's checkable on-hub without opening the app's code), and fixes the Third Party Services picker's description text visually colliding with its device-picker button - moved the guidance text into a paragraph before the input instead of the input's own description field, since that field renders as part of the same native widget as the button and Hubitat's internal layout there isn't something this app can adjust directly. 4.6.4 fixed the Presence Report CSV export to keep HH:MM text (forced literal via a spreadsheet-formula cell) after 4.6.3's decimal-hours attempt missed what was actually wanted. 4.6.3 fixed the Decision detail table still wrapping text letter by letter on mobile. 4.6.2 extended the Presence Report window from 30 to 90 days and added the CSV export. 4.6.1 fixed the default stale-evidence threshold (raised from 12 to 48 hours).
